name: Migratory Bird Sanctuaries along the Coast of Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf of China
description: Along China's Yellow Sea and Bohai Gulf coast, nineteen protected areas make up the world's largest intertidal wetland system, a vast belt of tidal mudflats. Over 400 bird species rely on it. For millions of migrating waterbirds, more than 10% of all travellers on the East Asian-Australasian Flyway, these flats are a vital refuelling stop between breeding and wintering grounds.
